visual_description: A rugged transport sled made of thick, weathered plywood with reinforced steel rails on the bottom. Heavy-duty yellow nylon ratchet straps are looped through the frame. In the center sits a large, white, rounded plaster jacket (resembling a large boulder) securely strapped down for transport.

constraints.scale: Should look massive and heavy, implying the need for multiple workers to move.
constraints.background: Isolated on a neutral grey studio floor.
